assertion.statement: In v2.0.0, Crossplane core no longer logs "Composition Functions are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-functions flag will be removed in a future release." What this means for the --enable-composition-functions flag is not stated.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: The evidence only shows that a log message saying the flag will be removed in a future release was deleted from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go in v2.0.0. It does not say whether the flag itself was removed, still exists, or is ignored. The excerpts contain no flag definitions.; consequence: The evidence does not say what happens in v2.0.0 to a Crossplane pod that still passes --enable-composition-functions (for example, rejected as unknown, ignored, or unchanged).
